episodes.title: Best of All Possible Worlds
episodes.summary: Silicon Valley: data, blackmail and a shaky grip on reality. Duncan, almost tech titan, must prove he and his company are F-able. JoAnne provides therapy with benefits. Orson lands from Baltimore. The party for Dr. Green ends in a cat burglary.

episodes.title: Shine Brightly
episodes.summary: A break-in escalates quickly. Bardolph knows how to STOP. JoAnne squirms in Duncan's grasp. Lili needs these diagnoses by yesterday. The press is on to a scandal. Bardolph's triggered. Xander gets the joke. Orson has his heart stolen by someone with practice. Gary's Pippin is - it's too awful to say.

episodes.title: Valley of Heart's Delight
episodes.summary: Duncan makes a lil pal. JoAnne futilely goes the extra mile. A song reminds everyone life is fragile. So do the wildfires. Zeus makes the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: Vanitas
episodes.summary: First rule of SV: do not talk about Smote's warehouse.

episodes.title: Lamplighters
episodes.summary: HyperG's salvation is close, but there's danger to Duncan. Duncan makes a treacherous voyage to a mysterious island to save his fortune from powerful enemies. Lili has a secret. Ghosts haunt the dumb house. Bardolph's #2 is all over HQ.

episodes.title: Sandbox
episodes.summary: It's war in the boardroom, bedroom, trophy case, and in the privacy of America's self-driving cars. Anushka takes Duncan's Serbian hat but rejects his fungus.

episodes.title: Foundering
episodes.summary: Duncan jumps on an opportunity while JoAnne contends with the consequences of her counsel. Anushka takes the lead and Martin faces a life-defining decision.

episodes.title: Granfalloon
episodes.summary: Everyone wears a turtleneck when presenting tech, except Dushka. Someone pays a dreadful cost. Darcy-other-Darcy is in the wrong place at the wrong time.
